candidates.snippet: All victims in the Oregon school shooting Thursday were shot inside one special needs classroom. A teacher tried to fight away the shooter's gun, helping to prevent more bloodshed before a father took down the shooter, police say. Follow live updates. https://t.co/OCOUiAcNOl

The judge overseeing Alex Murdaugh's highly anticipated retrial for the murders of his wife and son insisted the case would proceed to trial in six months and chastised the parties for squabbling over evidence during a two-hour hearing Friday. https://t.co/LXnG62Qg13 https://t.co
